title: Plan and chat disagree on a pack-years answer over 200
evidence: From the adversary on PR 1604 (7e61048f). The plan reads lung_pack_years with no range check (packages/health-core/src/screening-inputs.ts:139, parseLocalisedNumber), while the chat's sanitiser range-checks it to 0-200 (chat-context.ts screeningRows, screeningNumber). So an answer of 250 shows a lung card in the plan and not in the chat's plan. Options: range-check it in the plan too (an answer over 200 stops counting), or lift the chat's check. Either changes a clinical gate, so Brad decides. (H87)
